lines.en: I slide along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在板上没声响
lines.en: My claws make no sound on the boards.
I follow, step by step.
I walk inside the shadows.
I slip out from behind the cupboard.
I circle you half way round.

lines.zh: 我的身体很长，走得很慢
lines.en: My body is long, and I move slowly.
I pass along the door frame.
I crawl out from under the bed.
I inch my way toward you.
I stop behind you.
I work my way into the corridor.
I crouch in the corner.
I listen to the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，几乎看不见
lines.en: I hold still, almost invisible.
My eyes are in the dark.
I am waiting for the lights to go out.
I have been here a long while.
There is a dampness on me.
My head stays cocked.
I stay still in this corner.

lines.zh: 你的血在皮下跑得很快。
lines.en: Your blood runs fast under the skin.
My claws are drawn in.
I wait for you to turn.
There is a sound inside the wall.
I blink, once and again.

lines.zh: 我就在你灯照不到的地方。
lines.en: I am where your torch does not reach.
Do not turn around. You will regret it.
Whatever you do, do not turn round.
You hold your breath. I hear it.
All your fingers are trembling.
I have been waiting for you to be alone.
You cannot go fast at all.
My teeth are long and sharp.
You do not know where I am.
Count the doors.
I will not make a sound.

lines.zh: 这个屋子只有一个出口
lines.en: There is one way out of this room.
Do not look behind you.
I have been here a long time.
My hand is already out.
Stay right where you are.
My eyes are on you.
I shrink back into the dark.
I shudder, then go still.
That was a dull, heavy blow.
My claws have retracted.
I shrink back along the wall.
I have a smell about me now.
I am still in this room.
I move a little at a time.
I do not take that into my mouth.

lines.zh: 你举着手里的东西做什么
lines.en: What are you doing with that?
Keep that little thing.
This thing has no smell of blood.

lines.zh: 这些东西我不放在心上
lines.en: Such things mean little to me.
You brought food in here?
I do not feel hungry now.
It is you I would rather keep.
Take it elsewhere.
Your hand touched me.
I draw back a little.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底压在我的指节上。
lines.en: Your sole presses on my knuckle.
I slip past your side.
My hand brushes your sleeve.
Now you know.
I retreat to the wall.
Do not press against me.
My breath falls on the back of your neck.
This house is no place for that.
I only need one.
No need to ask.

lines.zh: 你已经在我的名单上了
lines.en: You are already on my list.
I slowly tip my head.
I have no need of a mate.
The walls hear everything.
I withdraw into the shadow.
Leave me in peace.
I take whatever falls.
I pinch it in my claws.
This does not shine at all.
I push it into a crack.
It slipped from my grip.
Whosever it is, I am keeping it.
I crush it with one hand.
This has no smell at all.
I set it in the corner.
I want teeth, not this.
You are alone.
I have finally got you.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，我抓住了。
lines.en: I have caught your scent.
Do not make a sound.
My claws have opened.
I am right at your back.
Turning will not help.

lines.zh: 这个屋子只有我们两个
lines.en: There are only two of us in this room.
I am coming toward you.
Did you hear that little noise?
I walk slowly. You still cannot escape.
You are cornered at the wall.
Everything on my side is set.

lines.zh: 我一直在数你喘气的次数
lines.en: I keep counting your breaths out.
You are five steps from the door.
My claws click softly.
I keep following behind you.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候我躲开了
lines.en: When you look back, I have slipped away.
I am at your flank now.
I shift a little more your way.
I hear your heart speed up.
I am right at the doorway.
I know which way you will go.
I have shifted position.
Do not plan on running.
Right at this instant.
The teeth in your shoulder are in deep.
My teeth sink into your arm.
You are dragged down.
My fingers are long.
You broke free once.
That came suddenly.
You smell of blood now.
I withdraw into the wall.
You have not gone down yet.
My claws rake your back.
I come again.
You are forced to the door.
The door will not open.
Teeth intact — I've always been here.
Do not look behind you.
I come slowly out of the wall.
The room has another shadow.
My fingers move first.
I crouch and wait.
The light does not reach this corner.
I was always on the other side of the wall.
The walls here are thin.
My breathing makes not a sound.
The shadow in the corner grows taller.
I took the spot behind the door.
It is dark here, good.
I watch the doorway.
I begin counting, one by one.
I have touched nothing.
My shadow is darker than the room.
I am right here in this room.
Did you hear that small noise?
Fire has lit the whole room.
I fall off the wall.
Water fills my mouth.
The blast slaps me against the wall.
An arrow bites into my calf.

lines.zh: 魔法照亮了我藏的地方
lines.en: Magic lights up where I hide.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里没有别的东西
lines.en: There is nothing else in this house.

lines.zh: 雷打在屋顶上，屋子亮了
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof and the room flares.

lines.zh: 我脚下的地板一下消失
lines.en: The floor under me vanishes.
